name: Ig2_Sphere_LevelSet_ScGeom
description: Creates or updates a ScGeom instance representing the intersection of one LevelSet-shaped body with one Sphere-shaped body, where overlap is always chosen to occur inside the level set body (i.e. spheres will always be expelled). Contact normal<ScGeom.normal> $ vec{n}$ is given by the level set...
